stories.title: Apple Ordered to Open iPhone to Rival App Stores in Australia

stories.more: MacRumors highlights the court's order as a significant shift in how Apple operates its ecosystem, emphasizing the implications of the 2025 ruling that found Apple misusing its market position. In contrast, 9to5Mac frames the decision as a response to a prolonged legal battle with Epic Games, noting that Apple has announced plans to appeal the ruling. Both outlets agree on the outcome but differ in their focus on the context and implications of the ruling.
